literal: He who does not examine, another person, he who trusted, to his lineage, unending, distress, will give.
translation: Trusting a stranger without examining their character will bring endless distress to one's entire lineage.
modern: ஆராய்ந்து பார்க்காமல் ஒருவரை நம்பித் தெளிந்தவனுடைய செயலே அவனது பரம்பரைக்கும் நீங்காத துன்பத்தைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet warns of the severe consequences of blind trust. The word 'தேரான்' describes someone who fails to investigate or analyze a person's character before employing or relying on them. If one blindly trusts ('தெளிந்தான்') such an unexamined stranger ('பிறனை'), the resulting failure does not stop with them. It brings endless, incurable misery ('தீரா இடும்பை') that plagues their entire lineage and descendants ('வழிமுறை').
